ValidationRule.description: Restricting the email access for customer connect cases to service lightning profile users
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR($Profile.Name == 'Qantas Service Lightning', $Profile.Name == 'Qantas Agency Connect and Agency Sales'), CONTAINS(Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName,"CCC") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have necessary access to send an email for this case
